# Copilot instructions

Follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root.

The key points:

- **Ask first.** Get explicit human confirmation before committing, pushing,
  or creating, editing, commenting on or merging issues, pull requests,
  releases, or workflows. Do not set up any auto-commit, auto-PR, auto-issue,
  or auto-merge automation.
- **No secrets or real data.** Never commit `.env`, `data/`, or `backups/`.
  Never add real patient data (PHI/PII). This repository is synthetic only.
